en.title: Converging Maze: Largest Sum Cycle
en.description:
Each cell numbered 0..N−1 has at most one one-way exit edge[i]; edge[i]=−1 means it has no exit. Output the maximum sum of node numbers over all directed cycles; output −1 if there is no cycle.

This site's explicit standard input/output format and supplementary constraints are part of the online version's definition and are not presented as the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains N (1..200000), and the second line contains N integers, each either −1 or in [0,N−1].
en.output: Output the maximum sum of node numbers in a cycle, or −1.
en.explanation: From each starting point, follow the unique successor, recording the position of each node on the current path; when you reach a node already on the current path, compute the node sum of the new cycle. After the full walk, mark the path as processed.
